collection.title: Volvo S80 2004 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Volvo S80 Saloon 2004 to 2006 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
